sma.tagline: AI-Powered Media Asset Management & Semantic Search System
sma.description: Architected a cloud-ready AI system enabling natural-language semantic search across video and image libraries with timestamp-level scene retrieval. Separated a dedicated AI Worker from the Backend API to isolate heavy tasks (Whisper transcription, OpenCV scene detection).
highlights: Separated AI Worker from Backend API
Vector search with pgvector on RDS

docmentor.tagline: AI document Q&A — upload PDF, ask anything
docmentor.description: Built a RAG pipeline that lets users upload PDF/DOCX and ask natural-language questions. Chunks with RecursiveCharacterTextSplitter (512 tokens, overlap 50), embeds via Sentence Transformers, stores in Pinecone, retrieves top-5 chunks as context for Gemini Pro. Streaming response via FastAPI SSE.
highlights: RAG pipeline with custom chunking strategy

dhlcinema.tagline: Real-time seat booking — zero double-booking under concurrent load
dhlcinema.description: Cinema ticket booking system solving the concurrent seat selection problem. Implemented Redis distributed lock (SET NX EX) for atomic reservation, Socket.io for real-time seat-map sync, and VNPay for payment. NEW: Integrated Self-Healing architecture with Cronjobs and TMDb API for automated movie syncing, dynamic schedule generation, and DB garbage collection, making the project 100% self-sustaining.
highlights: Redis Distributed Lock for atomic booking
